Video controls now show up on every video, with an option to keep them on screen.

**Fixed**
- The video controls now appear as soon as a video starts, including videos you swipe to in the viewer
- "Show controls when a video starts" is now on by default

**New**
- Settings → Media → Video player → Always show controls keeps the controls on screen the whole time a video plays
- The "Controls" setting is renamed "Control style"
